corrections.why: 15.2 m is 50 feet, the height of the 1921 Hanson tower moved to Pelham; the register gives the current steel tower as 68 feet (20.7 m)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says 68 ft; Wikipedia says the original tower was 80 ft; the 1921 report says 50 ft. The register and Wikipedia may describe different structures, so the story says their heights are not directly comparable, and uses the register's 68 ft for facts.height_m.

notes_for_editor: Register visit reports from 2016 (May says Sometimes, August says staffed) are the only staffing evidence, so facts.staffing is marked seasonal as of 2016. Access level public is inferred from the trail network; no source says whether the tower can be climbed, so no visit.climbable is given. A WebSearch snippet attributed to firelookout.org said the summit tower was taken down and moved to Plymouth by 1942; that page returned 404 from fetch_text and the claim was not used. It conflicts with the 2016 visit reports and Wikipedia's remains in seasonal use, so please check it before relying on the current tower's history. Heights disagree across sources (68 ft register, 80 ft Wikipedia, 50 ft 1921 report). Elevation differs too (1,174 ft register, 1,240 ft Wikipedia); the story notes it. No photos added: the register credits Jack Kelley for a 2016 photo, but no license was read.
